name: Transaction Certificate 4
definition: Certificate against which all currency control transactions are registered.

TransactionIdentification.name: Transaction Identification
TransactionIdentification.definition: Unique and unambiguous identification of the transaction.

Account.name: Account
Account.definition: Cash account, linked to the registered contract, on which the cash entry is made.

BankAccountDomiciliationCountry.name: Bank Account Domiciliation Country
BankAccountDomiciliationCountry.definition: Country in which the bank account is located, when the bank which services the account is located in another country.

SupplementaryData.name: Supplementary Data
SupplementaryData.definition: Additional information that cannot be captured in the structured elements and/or any other specific block.
